Its workPerformed, read in full: 'Extensive qualitative and quantitative research on alliances of salt producers in 19th century... How and why did a group of producers of a strategic commodity (salt), risk political tensions to advocate production slow-down'; finalResults: 'producers seeking to organize... The fact that they had to do this more or less below the governmental radar.' Critic adjudicates it OFF-TOPIC - the alliance's target is the industry's own output and it deliberately avoids government, so no attempt to influence adopted policy - but it is a 19th-century organised business group engaged in advocacy with explicit political stakes, a nearer miss than a water-supply history. It escapes every recorded query for three reasons: producer/alliance are not in the actor list; the policy regex 'polic' does not match 'political'; and the period marker sits in a different sentence from the advocacy claim, which defeats all three sentence-level proofs. The same gaps let 714905 CITIZINGLOBAL through ('Part A studies the puzzling popularity of protectionism and how lobbies can raise it by manipulating information' plus 'increasing country size in the 19th century') - the actor noun there is 'lobbies' itself, which the actor list does not contain. Separately, all seven recorded queries read p.objective and never p.title, so a project whose only period marker is in its title is outside the proof by construction.
